title: Beaver Wars
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Beaver Wars", at revision 1375676230, opens: "The Beaver Wars, also known as the Iroquois Wars or the French and Iroquois Wars, were a series of conflicts fought intermittently during the 17th century in North America throughout the Great Lakes region and the St. Lawrence River valley which pitted the Haudenosaunee (Iroquois) – who were supported by the Dutch and later the English – against neighbouring Indigenous nations such as the Wendat (Huron), who were supported by the French." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q856216, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1609–1701 wars between Hurons and Iroquois". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
